title: Decide the next scoring validation scope
why: Classification, routing, F3 and F8 retain measured limitations; further changes need a distinct hypothesis and a frozen evaluation gate.
what: Review residual errors and whole-product evidence gaps. Record which limits remain accepted or deferred, whether deterministic outage fallback is worth pursuing, and the next bounded hypothesis, fresh cases, success gate and cost scope. Keep current criteria until a separately approved comparison passes.

title: Restore reproducible private evaluation replays
why: Relocated evaluation scripts still resolve production imports through a missing directory, so their preserved replay commands are not usable as documented.
what: Repair a separate replay copy of the private evaluation harnesses and source-hash paths. Verify module resolution and meaningful offline checks with Node 22.22.2; preserve frozen inputs, outputs and rejected variants byte-for-byte. Document tested replay commands without making provider calls.

title: Evaluate extraction and real-agent refactoring outcomes
why: Fixture tests establish extraction and export mechanics but do not measure semantic coverage, requirement preservation or the usefulness of the receiving agent's edits.
what: Label a bounded set of instruction files, measure extracted versus contextual requirements, then compare the exported prompt with a plain refactoring request on the same files and receiving-agent setup. Assess preserved requirements, useful and unsupported edits, omissions and justified abstention. Record owner review separately from tests.

title: Review all translated interface journeys with native readers
why: The five translated locales have structural and rendering checks but no native-reader acceptance, including the file-review and exported-prompt handoff messages.
what: Arrange native review for Spanish, Chinese, Hindi, Arabic and French across single-rule, file-review, error, refusal, coverage and clipboard journeys. Record locale-specific feedback and unavailable reviewers; apply approved wording fixes, retain AI-translation disclosure where applicable, and rerun parity and rendered checks.

title: Validate accessibility and input on real devices
why: Viewport emulation, CSS zoom and mocked clipboard writes do not establish screen-reader, physical-input, native-zoom or operating-system clipboard behavior.
what: Exercise file and single-rule journeys on a recorded physical-device, browser and assistive-technology matrix. Check focus and announcements, touch/keyboard/IME input, native zoom, cancellation and real clipboard success/denial. Fix reproducible defects without redesign and record unavailable coverage and owner acceptance separately.

title: Prepare and verify the hosted file-review release
why: Local file-review and request-guard checks do not establish the deployed revision or confirm that hosted pages use the reviewed public content and edge protection.
what: Inspect the current deployed revision and a reviewed publishable bundle; verify product assets, privacy text, file workflow and rate-limit bindings. Prepare a bounded hosted smoke and rollback plan. Obtain explicit deployment and any paid-call authorization before execution, then record observed 429/503 behavior and remaining hosting limits.

title: Decide how to validate recurring user demand
why: The product remains free, while the documented question of whether users return for a repeatable need is still open.
what: Define the target user, recurring job, bounded evidence collection, success criteria and a review point using consented feedback or existing signals. Record whether evidence supports any next product step. Do not add analytics, contact users, introduce pricing or change privacy behavior without an explicit decision.

title: Decide whether to resume the remaining private rule research
why: The retained research leaves the prohibition-stall replication unresolved and a concreteness experiment at pilot design, with no current execution authorization.
what: Decide separately whether to resume, defer or retire the unresolved replication and proposed pilot. If retained, revalidate the host/model, define current cost limits and freeze the protocol; the larger concreteness study requires at least two qualifying pilot intents. Preserve private evidence and do not inherit historical budgets or run experiments.
